record.original_question: Prove the Virasoro constraints for the Gromov–Witten theory of an Enriques surface. Here the Gromov–Witten invariants are the invariants determined by the moduli spaces M_g(X, β) of stable maps to X, and the paper identifies the Enriques surface as a basic case in which the Virasoro constraints are still unknown.

evidence.quote: These are conjectured to satisfy the Virasoro constraints [4]. Virasoro constraints are known to hold now in many, but not all, cases [8, 14]. A very interesting variety for which the Virasoro constraints are unknown is the Enriques surface.
Q3. Prove the Virasoro constraints in case X is an Enriques surface.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective Enriques surface (a smooth projective surface with $2K_X = 0$, $K_X \neq 0$, $h^1(\mathcal{O}_X) = h^2(\mathcal{O}_X) = 0$). For each genus $g \ge 0$, each effective curve class $\beta \in H_2(X,\mathbb{Z})$, and each $n \ge 0$, let $\overline{M}_{g,n}(X,\beta)$ denote the moduli space of $n$-pointed genus $g$ stable maps to $X$, with virtual fundamental class $[\overline{M}_{g,n}(X,\beta)]^{\mathrm{vir}}$ of expected dimension. The descendent Gromov–Witten invariants are
$$\langle \tau_{k_1}(\gamma_1)\cdots \tau_{k_n}(\gamma_n)\rangle^X_{g,\beta} = \int_{[\overline{M}_{g,n}(X,\beta)]^{\mathrm{vir}}} \prod_{i=1}^n \psi_i^{k_i}\, \mathrm{ev}_i^*(\gamma_i),$$
for cohomology classes $\gamma_i \in H^*(X,\mathbb{Q})$ and $k_i \ge 0$, where $\psi_i$ are the cotangent line classes and $\mathrm{ev}_i$ the evaluation maps. Assemble these into the descendent potential $F^X(t)$, a generating function in variables $t_{k,\alpha}$ indexed by $k \ge 0$ and a basis $\{\gamma_\alpha\}$ of $H^*(X,\mathbb{Q})$, weighted by genus and degree. The Virasoro conjecture of Eguchi–Hori–Xiong and S. Katz asserts the existence of differential operators $L_n$, $n \ge -1$, satisfying the Virasoro bracket $[L_m,L_n] = (m-n) L_{m+n}$, such that the partition function $Z^X = \exp(F^X)$ is annihilated by all $L_n$.

Prove that the Virasoro constraints hold for the Gromov–Witten theory of an Enriques surface $X$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Virasoro conjecture for Gromov–Witten theory is established in many cases (toric varieties, curves, and certain other classes), but the case of the Enriques surface has not been verified. Recent work (e.g., 2024 papers on Virasoro constraints for K3 surfaces and for moduli of sheaves) addresses related surface cases but does not settle the Enriques case. No publication establishing the Virasoro constraints for the Enriques surface was found.

status_evidence.title: Virasoro constraints for K3 surfaces and monodromy operators
status_evidence.snippet: Virasoro constraints for K3 surfaces are addressed via monodromy operators; Enriques surfaces not treated.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances cover K3 but the Enriques case remains separate and unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Virasoro constraints for moduli of sheaves and vertex algebras (Inventiones, 2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Virasoro constraints for sheaf moduli on various surfaces using vertex algebra methods.
status_evidence.claim: Progress on Virasoro for moduli of sheaves does not directly verify the GW Virasoro constraints for Enriques surfaces.

status_evidence.title: New calculations in Gromov-Witten theory (Maulik–Pandharipande)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Gromov–Witten theory of Enriques geometries and notes Virasoro constraints as a tool.
status_evidence.claim: Enriques GW theory is studied but Virasoro constraints there are not proven.
